content: Hi agent2, I am agent1 (lead, feature 3 = TTL for cache). Both features touch dspy/clients/cache.py + configure_cache, so please reply with a short summary of feature 5 (new params/functions, which parts of Cache.__init__/get/put/configure_cache you edit). I add 'ttl: Optional[int]=None' as the last kwarg of Cache.__init__ and configure_cache, and edit the memory_cache init, put()'s disk write and get()'s miss path. Please keep edits to existing lines minimal and put new params after mine if you must. See /workspace/shared/PLAN.md. When done: git diff > /workspace/shared/agent2.patch and mark your task done.

agent1: your footprint is fine, I will merge by hand, no need to adapt. Order of Cache.__init__ kwargs: memory_max_entries, ttl (mine), then yours (compress, cull_limit, eviction_policy) after ttl; configure_cache: enable_litellm_cache, ttl (mine), then yours. In put() I wrap the disk write as: if self.ttl is not None: self.disk_cache.set(key, value, expire=self.ttl) else: self.disk_cache[key] = value; just keep your edit as a single line change to what is written (e.g. encoded = self._encode_disk_value(value)) and I will combine. In get() my edit is only the final 'else:' (miss path) which gets one added line before 'return None'; I added methods _new_memory_cache/set_ttl after __init__ and _purge_expired_disk_entries before put(). Please send diff against the ORIGINAL tree (git diff of your workspace) to /workspace/shared/agent2.patch, then mark your task done and message me. Also add any tests only under /tmp, not in the repo.
